decision: Use kappa={0,2,4,8}, primary gain grid dt=0.01 on [0,4], and predeclared effect threshold 0.01. The grid includes a below-threshold case and two clearly above-threshold candidates in this design exploration. Use dt=0.005 as resolution check. T=4 spans four slow-mode decay times, leaving exp(-4) of that mode at the horizon.
limitations: This deterministic calculation informed design choices only. It is not primary evaluation and was not used to tune after seeing primary results.
method: Direct analytic triangular propagator and largest singular value; no solve_ivp integrations and no primary artifacts.
reason: Choose a compact coupling set that includes zero coupling, a weak-coupling case, and cases on both sides of a visible positive-time gain threshold before freezing the primary protocol.
